decisions.reason: As a sensor module that fits the firm's core modular measurement platform, it is still worth keeping unless several years of sales and support experience now clearly show limited demand or component-related disadvantages.
Because it is the successor generation of an established voltage-measurement module in a core function area, management would normally continue it unless a newer replacement is already imminent.
The MQTT proxy is a low-cost software complement whose maintenance burden is modest, so the firm would usually retain it as long as it adds ecosystem value for industrial and IoT integrations.
A CAN bus interface remains strategically relevant for German automation and embedded customers, making it sensible to keep unless accumulated demand evidence has turned clearly disappointing.

After several years on the market, a peripheral touch accessory that is less central to the firm's modular platform has likely revealed its limited option value, so resources are better redirected to core modules and new development.
